proposal.summary: A flaw in io_uring fixed buffer registration (io_sqe_buffer_register in io_uring/rsrc.c) permits out-of-bounds access to physical memory beyond the end of the buffer, enabling full local privilege escalation.

AC.quote: + ALLOWING ATTACKER TO EXPLOIT WITHOUT SPECIAL CONDITIONS (kernel code path)

proposal.recommended_next_step: Develop and deploy a patched kernel update addressing the out-of-bounds access in io_sqe_buffer_register; perform memory safety review of io_uring buffer registration paths and include regression tests to prevent buffer overflows.

evidence_quotes.quote: A flaw was found in the fixed buffer registration code for io_uring (io_sqe_buffer_register in io_uring/rsrc.c) in the Linux kernel that allows out-of-bounds access to physical memory beyond the end of the buffer. This flaw enables full local privilege escalation.
